Cleanup BVFS cache for a certain handle.

## Synopsis

```text
.bvfs_cleanup path=<path>
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Drops the table that .bvfs\_restore created for a restore selection, after the restore was started with file=?&lt;table&gt; or abandoned. path= names the table (b2 followed by a number); other names are skipped silently and a missing table is not an error. The BVFS cache stays.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path=` | string |  |  | required | Handle (table name). |

## Examples

Drop a restore selection table:

```text
.bvfs_cleanup path=b2101
```
